name: United Houma Nation (United States)
description: A square red field with a yellow border, charged at the centre with the tribal seal: a black ring inscribed 'United Houma Nation' in white around a yellow ring and a white disc bearing a red crawfish.
history: The crawfish is the traditional emblem of the Houma people of southern Louisiana.

features.role: seal of the United Houma Nation with a red crawfish
